nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can supply-side practices in agriculture contribute to climate change mitigation?
nodes.answer: According to the IPCC special report on climate change and land, supply-side practices can contribute to climate change mitigation by reducing crop and livestock emissions, sequestering carbon in soils and biomass, and decreasing emission intensity within sustainable production systems.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Climate-smart agriculture|Soil carbon sequestration practices_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How can both measurement and modeling approaches benefit analyses of land management practices for soil C sequestration?
nodes.answer: A combination of direct measurements for validation purposes and modeling at larger scales can help define the efficacy of different land management practices in enhancing soil C sequestration.
